profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer at Prov Inc., a Utah-based professional licensing and credentialing platform. I work across the full stack to design, build, and maintain software systems that power online testing and certification for clients nationwide.
Key contributions include:

- Built and deployed automated score delivery pipelines using PHP, SQL, and Python — eliminating manual reporting processes and ensuring consistent, on-time delivery at scale
- Architected a self-service candidate login solution that reduced call center volume by 25%+
- Developed custom score letter systems for external clients using PHP and Handlebars, serving as the primary technical point of contact for client-specific requirements
- Leading development of an internal AI chatbot using React, Python FastAPI, and the Claude API to enable natural language querying of internal databases
- Delivered automation solutions using Python, Selenium, and Task Scheduler to eliminate recurring manual workflows

positions.title: Technical Assistant
positions.description:
•	Script formulas in Microsoft Excel to maximize efficiency with projections and calculations.
•	Formulate MailMerges to transfer data from Excel directly into templated Microsoft Word letters.
•	Draft construction plans for a variety of pools, houses, and light poles.
•	Conduct inspections on construction sites to verify the progress matched the plans.
